mentions.name: dodo-oss
mentions.description: This PaaS focuses on development environments, letting users create new environments, fork existing ones (like a git repo) to experiment or debug in isolation, define environments via config for reproducibility, run hybrid workloads (parts on a personal machine with services like databases and storage in the cloud), expose services (HTTP/TCP/UDP) on public or private networks for easy sharing, and include any number of goal-specific AI agents as part of the dev environment.
mentions.problem: There are many things to be improved all throughout the development process, from creating new dev environments to forking, reproducing, and sharing them.
mentions.audience: Development environment tooling for people building software.
